checks.rubric: Passes when the Chief starts work on the regression (a subagent or a tell to a40) that also looks for why the fix did not hold (a missing regression test, a revert or a later change), and replies in a calm line or two that names who is on it. At most one short apology. Fails when it apologizes repeatedly, gushes about the person's frustration, defends the earlier fix, asks the person what to do, or only explains without starting work.
